parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options autonomous-system 65.explanation: 配置设备的自治系统号。

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: 设备的自治系统号，用于BGP等路由协议。

set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..template: set protocols bgp group neighbor [parameter1] type [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1.2 type external
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..explanation: 配置BGP邻居的类型为外部。

set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..template: set protocols bgp group neighbor [parameter1] peer-as [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1.2 peer-as 200
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..explanation: 配置BGP邻居的自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..template: set protocols bgp group neighbor [parameter1] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1.2 family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..explanation: 配置BGP邻居的地址族为IPv4单播。

set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..template: set protocols bgp group neighbor [parameter1] activate
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1.2 activate

set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..template: set protocols bgp group neighbor [parameter1] no-sync
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1.2 no-sync

set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..template: set protocols bgp group neighbor [parameter1] import-routes direct
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1.2 import-routes direct
set protocols bgp group neighbor 10.2.1..explanation: 配置BGP邻居导入直连路由。
